summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.95. Account i.tekin@aegean.edu shows confirmed account takeover. Normal baseline: successful portal login from AS-AEGEAN-EDU (TR/Manisa) on known device DEV-H01-D. On 2026-10-12, a rapid succession of successful logins originated from 203.0.113.58 (Contabo GmbH, DE/Nuremberg — a hosting provider, not the university network) with no device_id, no VPN, and zero MFA prompts across mail, portal, and sis apps (impossible travel from Turkey to Germany within minutes). At 02:16:40, shortly after the first German mail login (02:14:07), an inbox rule was created forwarding mail to external address l1b-archive@protonmail.com via API — a classic persistence/data-exfiltration action. Together (anomalous hosting IP, impossible travel, missing device/MFA, multi-app access, external forwarding rule) this is confirmed compromise, not a weak or explained signal. Immediate containment is required: disable the account, reset credentials, revoke all sessions, and remove the forwarding rule.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
